answer: Each submission hangs on the orchard of a task receipt, and the relic is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the tundra of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
